Lesson: picking the model is the easy part; the hard part is what data and features go into the dataset.

records.process_summary: 5 rounds: coding + ML basics; DL/NLP/CV specialization; hiring-manager conceptual discussion; project deep dive; system design. ~20% of every round is resume-based.
records.rounds_and_questions_detail: R1: minimum-cost path in a matrix (DP; pros/cons vs greedy). R2: encoder-only vs decoder-only vs encoder-decoder models; fine-tuning first vs last layer; transformer internals (self-attention matrices, positional embeddings); GloVe vs BERT; BLEU score; NER pipelines; RNN/LSTM vs Transformers; Graph RAG. R3 (HM): why LLMs over classical NLP; GenAI challenges; fine-tune vs embeddings; prompt engineering business cases. R4: project deep dive - RAG design, model monitoring, drift detection, multimodal projects, model compression, PEFT/LoRA, inference latency, architecture choices. R5: design a review-summarization system WITHOUT LLMs (pre-LLM era): SQL input, tokenization, sentiment/aspect extraction, TF-IDF/embeddings, seq2seq (T5), ROUGE/BLEU/embedding-similarity evaluation, category fine-tuning.
